expression.data: Khan_xtrain.csv and Khan_ytrain.csv only; never open the test files
expression.null: Unrestricted training-label permutations preserving class counts, refitting all preprocessing and inner selection
expression.decision: Exploratory permutation p <= 0.05; no clinical inference or test-cohort retuning

enrichment.universe: finite adjusted-p genes in frozen raw RNA result
enrichment.statistic: minimum BH-adjusted p and discovery count for each possible size-one foreground
enrichment.decision: If no singleton yields BH < 0.05, no possible singleton discovery under this fixed universe and term family
